title: Solver-Aware Decompositions for Programming-by-Example: When Dividing Requires Knowing how to Conquer
abstract: arXiv:2608.03461v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Decomposition-based Programming-by-example (PBE) scales performance by splitting tasks into subtasks that a learned synthesizer solves: a decomposer predicts intermediate subgoals, and a synthesizer generates programs conditioned on them. Execution-decomposition approaches such as ExeDec train the decomposer to imitate ground-truth (GT) subgoals, implicitly treating decomposition quality as intrinsic to the task. We challenge this assumption: for bounded solvers with fixed inductive biases, GT decompositions reflect the annotator's factorization choices - not the solver's search dynamics. A decomposer trained to match GT decompositions may therefore propose subgoals that are logically valid yet intractable for the solver. We propose Solver-Aware Decomposition (SAD), a training framework that retains supervised training on GT subgoals as a structural scaffold, while additionally optimizing the decomposer online with policy gradients a

translated_title: 面向示例编程的求解器感知分解：当“分而治之”需要懂得如何“治”
translated_abstract: 基于分解的示例编程通过将任务拆分为由学习到的合成器所解决的子任务来扩展性能：分解器预测中间子目标，合成器则以这些子目标为条件生成程序。诸如ExeDec等执行分解方法通过训练分解器模仿真实子目标，隐含地将分解质量视为任务本身的内在属性。我们挑战这一假设：对于具有固定归纳偏置的有界求解器而言，真实分解反映的是标注者的因子分解选择，而非求解器的搜索动态。因此，训练为匹配真实分解的分解器可能会提出在逻辑上有效但求解器难以处理的子目标。我们提出求解器感知分解（SAD），这是一个训练框架，它保留对真实子目标的监督训练作为结构支架，同时额外使用策略梯度在线优化分解器（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出求解器感知分解（SAD）训练框架，在保留真实子目标监督训练的基础上，通过策略梯度在线优化使分解器感知求解器的实际搜索能力，从而提出对求解器真正可解的子目标，提升基于分解的示例编程性能。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Solver-Aware Decomposition (SAD), a training framework that augments supervised learning on ground-truth subgoals with online policy-gradient optimization, making the decomposer aware of the solver's capabilities so that its proposed subgoals are actually tractable for the synthesizer.
